rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single user ID before acting, then requested and received explicit confirmation prior to updating the default address. The modify_user_address tool call used the confirmed details and succeeded, and the agent accurately confirmed the update. When the user asked to revert to the original Denver address, the agent correctly requested the full street address to avoid guessing or fabricating data, did not perform any write without sufficient information or confirmation, and honored the user’s request to transfer to a human agent. There were no unsupported statements, no actions taken on the wrong account, and no unconfirmed writes. The user did not explicitly request changes to existing orders’ addresses, so not attempting those was appropriate given the policy and toolset.
